listenings.text: Good evening, everybody, and welcome to the Garden. Before you order, let me tell you about the three specials of today, because they are not on the menu. The first one is a soup with pumpkin and ginger. It is warm and it is not spicy, so it is good for children. The second is fish of the day, and today it is salmon, with potatoes and green vegetables. And the third one is a pasta with mushrooms, and it is the only vegetarian special tonight. The bread and the water for the table are free, and we bring more if you ask. One more thing, and it is important: if anybody at the table has an allergy, please tell me now, before you order, and not after the food arrives. Thank you, and enjoy your evening.

Hello, this is the Garden restaurant, returning your call about Saturday. We have a table for four at half past seven, and we can keep it for you until quarter to eight. If you are late, please call us, because on Saturday we are full and we give the table away after fifteen minutes. You asked about children: yes, we have a small menu for them, and we have high chairs. You also asked about the nuts. I checked with the kitchen this morning: the pasta and the fish have no nuts, the salad has no nuts, but the chocolate cake does. The kitchen can make a fruit plate for your son instead, with no extra cost. Please tell the waiter when you arrive. See you on Saturday.

extra_audio.text: Good evening. A table for four, please. Can I have the menu? I would like a salad, and can we have some bread? Thank you very much.
